notes: Week 9 reproduced all 78 prior tickets exactly. Added five modeled kickoff bindings: three from contemporaneous primary-school schedule evidence and two from unflagged canonical conditional kickoff displays that agree with the original CBS table. All five were fully priced on the fixed board. Five modeled kickoff gaps remain; Sam Houston at Missouri State retains a 7:00 versus 7:05 CT source difference.

Week 8 used the October 18 12:02Z fixed board. Exact original forecast strings were extracted after checking accepted ZIP SHA-256. All 49 modeled directed IDs joined to canonical finals and original board rows. The strict replay used five matching qualified saved kickoff clocks, of which four had six numeric price branches. The schedule-date sensitivity cohort requires the original target UTC date and the CBS display UTC date to agree, plus six numeric prices. It is exploratory and provides no independent exact kickoff verification. It overlaps the strict sample and must not be pooled with it.
All results use hypothetical $5 selections. Week 8 broader totals reversed the Week 9 and Week 10 direction, so the early apparent weakness is coverage-sensitive.

rule.spread: Choose the side with the larger strictly positive projected cover margin. Home projection = pred_margin + home line. Away projection = -pred_margin + away line. Skip equal positive margins or no positive margin.
rule.ml: Choose home if frozen home win probability exceeds 0.5, away if below 0.5, and skip equality. No price or EV threshold.
rule.total: Choose the side with the larger strictly positive projected margin over its own line. Over = pred_total minus over line. Under = under line minus pred_total. Skip equal positive margins or no positive margin.
rule.grading: Flat hypothetical $5 per selection, score from qualified full-game finals, pushes refund. Round positive profits half up per ticket to cents. Zero selection yields zero net and undefined ROI. Fixed rule specified before this calculation on an already completed historical cohort, so exploratory only.
